visual_caveats.identity: Dark cool charcoal/slate-gray polygon stone paving with narrow brown-gray joints and medium infill; a few subtle broad fractures on main stones. Original dark floor identity retained, no forge objects, glow or wet sheen.
visual_caveats.detail_density: Approximately 5-7 main stones across the image, fewer and larger than the requested 8-12. Medium joint infill is quite abundant and some small chips remain.
visual_caveats.scale_caveat: Main stone widths are approximately 30-70 world units at a 256-unit full-source period, with occasional larger faces. Initial world period is a parent preview parameter, not an accepted gameplay scale.
visual_caveats.style_caveat: Broad quiet face planes and low-contrast dark palette. Residual fine face texture and a few ragged plane edges remain; no programmatic cleanup.
visual_caveats.native_acceptance: 1254 fully opaque native, material identity retained. Active tone 0 source candidate for c01-14; not a scene binding or seamlessness pass.

visual_caveats.style_caveat: Dark matte rounded paving retained, warmer and somewhat more brown than original. Residual subtle face texture remains and is documented without filtering.

visual_caveats.identity: Muted brown compact earth with incomplete rectangular paving remnants at upper right and lower left, plus scattered angular stone groups. Original interrupted-paving identity and two main remnant locations retained; no continuous cobble floor, curving road, fire or symbols.
visual_caveats.detail_density: Earth uses broad dark/light patches but retains many smaller low-contrast patch edges. Scattered stone groups are more numerous and larger than the quiet sparse target. Remnant paving faces have some extra small mottled planes.
visual_caveats.scale_caveat: Largest paving blocks would span about 30-55 world units at a 256-unit period; smaller scattered stones commonly about 7-18 units. These are visual material marks, not new collision objects.
visual_caveats.style_caveat: Some loose stones show shallow visible side faces and may read slightly raised. The soil is the most detailed component and is documented rather than programmatically smoothed. Original overall brown identity remains close.
visual_caveats.native_acceptance: 1254 fully opaque native; original tone 2 catalog-only, no runtime binding or natural seamlessness claim.

visual_caveats.identity: Deep cool charcoal-blue-gray rounded-polygon paving with broad smoother main faces and subdued medium joint infill. Less fractured and cleaner than forge-stone-1, no invented fire, metal, glow or water.
visual_caveats.detail_density: Approximately 4-6 dominant main stones across width, fewer/larger than proposed 8-12; many medium infill stones remain. Large faces use broad low-contrast gray planes with minimal cracks.
visual_caveats.scale_caveat: Main stones often span about 40-80 world units at the proposed 256-unit period. Preview scale is not final production acceptance and does not alter rules.
visual_caveats.style_caveat: This is the cleanest large-face paving of the quartet, though small joint stones and soft face mottling remain. Native pixels preserved without smoothing.
visual_caveats.native_acceptance: 1254 fully opaque native, smooth cool paving identity retained. Original tone 3 catalog-only, no scene binding or natural seamlessness claim.
visual_caveats.palette_caveat: The overall RGB mean is approximately 58.5/57.9/57.6, more neutral and very slightly warmer than the original 55.6/57.4/59.2. The original cool-blue cast has been weakened, not exactly matched.
